- [IRET.1.5] **Fixed-width fact value arrays.** A fact's
  slot values are stored in a flat array of `ds_rete_val_t`
  sized at schema-definition time. No per-fact heap
  allocation for non-`Json` slots. `Json` slots hold a
  separately-allocated UTF-8 blob; its pointer is stored
  in the value array.
